description: [Merchant] Create JWT token for payware API authentication according to official documentation

partnerId.description: Partner ID from payware dashboard. Uses PAYWARE_PARTNER_ID env var as default.

privateKey.description: RSA private key - accepts PEM format with/without headers or raw base64 content. Uses environment-specific private key as default.

requestBody.description: Request body for a POST, PUT or PATCH, which then needs contentSha256. An object is serialized once (keys sorted, no spaces) and the result shows that exact string: send it byte for byte. A string is hashed as given.

useSandbox.description: Sign with the sandbox key (default) or the production key; a token signed with one environment's key is refused by the other

name: payware_authentication_create_jwt_token
